assets: Trees, rocks and ground plants: Quaternius Ultimate Nature Pack. Courier: original simple character. No rigged animal assumed.
hook: Movement-first exploration with tiny stories, no combat, and a forest that lights up as you reconnect it.
loop: Glide between giant trees, deliver lost letters, and restore a forgotten woodland postal route.
risk: Low–medium: glide feel and clear navigation. Best first prototype.
slice: One grove · three delivery stops · one glider upgrade · 8–10 minutes.
title: MOSSMAIL

assets: Ship parts, satellites and station modules: Quaternius Ultimate Space Kit. Tether and salvage tools: original geometry.
hook: Quiet space exploration with satisfying magnetic tools and short, risky salvage runs.
loop: Tether to derelict satellites, pull out valuable modules, and return before your oxygen runs low.
risk: Medium: constrain movement to a plane first; full six-axis flight is a later feature.
slice: One wreck · three salvage objects · oxygen timer · return beacon.
title: DRIFT / SALVAGE

assets: Walls, pillars and doors: Quaternius Ultimate Dungeon Pack. Lantern, flame and light switches: original models/effects.
hook: Your light is both your safety and the key. Spend it carefully, then earn it back.
loop: Carry your fading lantern through an abandoned temple; share its flame with mechanisms to open the way.
risk: Low–medium: strong atmosphere with a small asset set. Limit shadow-casting lights on iPad.
slice: Three rooms · two light puzzles · one exit · no enemies in the first build.
title: LAST WICK

assets: Palms, vegetation and rocks: Quaternius Ultimate Nature Pack. Boat, docks and beacons: original low-poly geometry.
hook: A readable, diorama-sized world changes visibly with every repair. No survival grind.
loop: Sail a miniature lagoon, collect stranded supplies, and repair three beacons to bring the harbor back to life.
risk: Medium: boat handling and transparent water. Start with flat opaque stylized water.
slice: One lagoon · three islands · one boat · three repairs.
title: TIDELINE

assets: Trees, rocks and foliage: Quaternius Ultimate Nature Pack. Platforms, marble and goals: original primitives.
hook: Toy-sized worlds, big shortcuts: a short skill game built around feel and replayable times.
loop: Tilt and roll a marble across floating garden courses, collect stars, then find the finish portal.
risk: Low: easiest full playable loop; camera and physics need careful tuning.
slice: One course · three checkpoints · five collectibles · instant reset.
title: POCKET PEAKS
